topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can hardly believe what I've come to learn. Tom, he's been telling all and sundry about his grand job in the city, dressed up like a lord every Sunday when he comes back. Wanted folks to think he’s part of something big, something grand. But it turns out, he’s just been labouring, no different from us. Been spinning tales to make himself seem more, to puff himself up over the rest of us. I’ve half a mind to give him a piece of my mind next time I see him. What’s the harm in being honest, I say? It’s the straight path that brings the true harvest, not lies and false tales.
